plan.summary: Zoho OAuth Adim 2 Paket B: token provider (lazy refresh + IMemoryCache + per-tenant lock) + connection orchestrator (encrypt via IDataProtector + persist) + 2 endpoint (auth-protected /api/v1/zoho/connect-url + public /integrations/zoho/callback) + Program.cs DI wiring (Data Protection + IMemoryCache + Zoho services).
plan.q_intent: Paket A foundation hazir (schema, region resolver, state JWT, repository). Paket B uctan uca OAuth flow'u tamamlar: kullanici Bagla butonuna basar -> JWT-protected endpoint Zoho authorize URL'i uretir; Zoho callback URL'sine redirect olur; public callback endpoint state validate eder, code'u token'a cevirir, refresh_token'i encrypt edip DB'ye yazar; bundan sonra IZohoTokenProvider lazy refresh ile her API cagirisi icin valid access_token saglar.
plan.interview_notes: Paket A'da Q karari: Data Protection API encryption + Lazy refresh + Signed JWT state + 10dk TTL. Paket B bunlari implement eder. Endpoint stratejisi: authorize JWT-protected (/api/v1/ prefix), callback public (Zoho browser redirect, JWT impossible). Zoho rate limit lazy refresh ile sorun olmuyor (tokens uzun omurlu, refresh nadir).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: GET /api/v1/zoho/connect-url JWT ile cagrildiginda Zoho authorize URL'i doner; URL ?response_type=code&client_id&scope&redirect_uri&access_type=offline&prompt=consent&state=<HMAC-signed> formatinda; default region (eu) uzerinden uretilir.

GET /integrations/zoho/callback?code=...&state=...&accounts-server=... cagrildiginda: state validate edilir, code Zoho /oauth/v2/token endpoint'ine POST edilir, donen refresh_token IDataProtector ile encrypt edilir, zoho_connections row upsert edilir; tarayiciya basarili HTML sayfasi doner.
Invalid/expired state JWT ile callback 400 + INV-INT-111 doner; bilinmeyen accounts-server icin 400 + INV-INT-110; Zoho token endpoint hata icin 502 + INV-INT-113.

IZohoTokenProvider.GetAccessTokenAsync(tenantId): cache hit'te dogrudan token doner (DB/HTTP yok); cache miss'te per-tenant SemaphoreSlim lock altinda DB'den encrypted refresh_token okur, decrypt eder, Zoho refresh endpoint'ine POST eder, donen access_token (expires_in - 60s) TTL ile cache'ler.
Build PASS: dotnet build src/Invekto.Integrations/Invekto.Integrations.csproj 0 hata. Microservice isolation korunur (Shared disinda foreign Invekto.* using yok).

gr_list.description: IZohoTokenProvider arayuzu (GetAccessTokenAsync + InvalidateCache) + ZohoErrorCodes service-local sabit sinifi (INV-INT-110..119).

ZohoTokenProvider: HttpClient (15s timeout) + IDataProtectionProvider + IMemoryCache + ConcurrentDictionary<int, SemaphoreSlim> per-tenant lock; double-check locking pattern; Zoho refresh_token rotation handle (Update vs TouchRefreshed); expires_in - 60s safety buffer (min 60s); ExchangeAuthorizationCodeAsync method (one-shot, NOT cached).

ZohoConnectionService: BuildAuthorizeUrl (default region config + state sign + URL escape); HandleCallbackAsync (state verify -> region resolve -> code exchange -> refresh_token Protect -> Upsert -> InvalidateCache); typed exceptions with INV-INT-* prefix.

ZohoConnectEndpoints: 2 minimal API endpoint - GET /api/v1/zoho/connect-url (JWT via existing UseJwtAuth) + GET /integrations/zoho/callback (public); structured ErrorResponse envelope; success HTML page on callback (browser is the client); MapException helper INV-INT-* code -> HTTP status mapping.

Program.cs DI: AddDataProtection().SetApplicationName().PersistKeysToFileSystem(C:\Invekto\Integrations\keys); AddMemoryCache; ZohoConnectionRepository + ZohoRegionResolver + ZohoOAuthStateService (Jwt:SecretKey) + ZohoTokenProvider (HttpClient typed) + ZohoConnectionService singleton; MapZohoConnectEndpoints; /api/ops/endpoints listesine 2 yeni entry.

build.notes: 0 errors, 0 warnings. Iter 1 fixed 3 errors: missing using Invekto.Shared.Auth (TenantContext), CS0173 null:null branches, missing using Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection (SetApplicationName extension).

verification_questions.question: ZohoTokenProvider per-tenant lock (ConcurrentDictionary<int, SemaphoreSlim>) double-check pattern dogru calisiyor mu? Cache miss + lock + re-check + refresh + cache + release siralamasi correct?

Refresh token rotation: Zoho refresh response'unda RefreshToken NULL ise eski refresh_token tutuyoruz (TouchRefreshedAsync); NOT NULL ise yeni refresh_token IDataProtector ile encrypt edip UpdateRefreshTokenAsync ile saklarz. Plain text DB yazma yolu yok.

Public callback endpoint /integrations/zoho/callback JWT ile korunmuyor (Zoho browser redirect bunu engellemez), ama state JWT HMAC ile imzali olduğu icin saldirgan baska tenant'in callback'ini hijack edemez. State 10dk TTL'li.
DataProtection key ring C:\Invekto\Integrations\keys'te persist edilir; process restart sonrasi encrypted refresh_token decrypt edilebilir mi? (PersistKeysToFileSystem + sabit ApplicationName)
Callback handler typed exception (InvalidOperationException with INV-INT-* prefix) -> MapException -> ErrorResponse envelope + HTTP status (400/502/503/500). Sessiz hata yok.

non_goals: Hangfire recurring refresh (lazy karari Q tarafindan onaylandi)
OAuth sign-out endpoint (DisconnectAsync repository'de var, endpoint Adim 3)
intentional_exclusions: JWT lib state token icin (Paket A custom HMAC format)
Shared abstraction (IEncryptionService) - Integrations icinde local kal

try_catch_locations: ZohoTokenProvider.PostTokenAsync: catch HttpRequestException + TaskCanceledException + JsonException -> INV-INT-114 typed wraps
ZohoConnectEndpoints callback: catch InvalidOperationException -> MapException -> ErrorResponse envelope
user_facing_errors: INV-INT-111 'Bağlantı oturumu geçersiz veya süresi dolmuş; tekrar deneyin.' (400)
INV-INT-115 'Bu hesap için Zoho bağlantısı bulunamadı.' (500)
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Tum hata yollari typed exception ile yukseliyor; endpoint MapException -> structured ErrorResponse + HTTP status. Cache miss sessiz degil; lock sirasinda Zoho refresh fail ederse exception caller'a gider.

aha_moments.user_pain: Yuksek istek anliginda 100 paralel API call ayni anda refresh tetiklerse Zoho rate limit (200 req/dk) asilir.
aha_moments.suggestion: Per-tenant SemaphoreSlim + double-check cache pattern: TEK refresh, diger 99 onun sonucunu paylasir.
aha_moments.aha_moment: 100 paralel cagri = 1 Zoho refresh request, hicbir rate limit problemi yok.

aha_moments.user_pain: Servis restart sonrasi access_token cache temizlenir, ilk istek Zoho'ya gider.
aha_moments.suggestion: DataProtection key ring C:\Invekto\Integrations\keys'te persist; refresh_token decrypt edilebilir, lazy refresh yeni access_token uretir.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Restart sonrasi ilk istek 1-2sn yavas, sonrakiler instant.

aha_moments.user_pain: Hata olunca 'bir sorun olustu' demek destek ekibini ucturuyor.
aha_moments.suggestion: Her hata yolu INV-INT-110..119 spesifik kod + actionable TR mesaj + HTTP status; ErrorResponse envelope X-Request-Id ile log korelasyonu.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Hasta destekten arar, requestId verir, 5sn'de hata izole edilir.

aha_moments.user_pain: Yeni tenant geldiginde manuel adim gerekir.
aha_moments.suggestion: GET /api/v1/zoho/connect-url tek tik ile authorize URL uretiyor; tenant context JWT'den geliyor; otomatik akis.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Tenant 'Bagla' der, 30sn'de active connection, hicbir manuel kurulum yok.

aha_moments.user_pain: Callback URL public, saldirgan baska tenant'a ait callback'i forge edebilir mi?
aha_moments.suggestion: State HMAC-SHA256 imzali (Jwt:SecretKey), 10dk TTL, FixedTimeEquals timing-safe compare, payload tampered tespiti garantili.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Forge edilemez; state validation fail = 400 INV-INT-111, log'a yansir.

Iter 1 PASS 12/12 CQ + 5/5 CoVe: (a) MapException expanded all 10 INV-INT-110..119 with specific HTTP statuses 400/404/409/429/500/502/503; (b) actionable next-step text on every exception (INV-INT-117 reconnect, INV-INT-114 firewall+timeout+rate-limit hints, INV-INT-116 appsettings remediation); (c) CRITICAL evidence Q3/CQ5/CQ9: codebase pattern UseJwtAuth(...,'/api/v1/') only on /api/v1/ prefix; pre-existing public endpoints /health, /ready, /api/ops/endpoints; OAuth callback at /integrations/zoho/callback follows same convention + RFC 6749 §3.1.2/§10.12 requires public callback (browser cannot send Bearer); state HMAC-SHA256 signed + 10min TTL + FixedTimeEquals = OAuth-standard CSRF defense.
